items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: that disturbed Dick Katz and Orrin Keepnews a little bit

ctx.x: Let’s talk about the Duets album from sixty-seven. This is your first major record after Motion. This is part of the beginnings of Milestone Records that Dick Katz and Orrin Keepnews started . . . That was an important record for them. That got a lot of attention and for you as well.
